Yes. Firecrawl's careers page lists five legal roles, all full-time:

| Role | Location | Link |
|---|---|---|
| General Counsel | San Francisco, CA | [apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/firecrawl/0c635f7b-559b-4bca-930a-fcac4a9c4a7d) |
| Senior Commercial & Product Counsel | San Francisco, CA | [apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/firecrawl/0995d222-ec66-4542-b9cc-3914c5d080c6) |
| Commercial Counsel | San Francisco or Toronto (preferred), or remote in the Americas | [apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/firecrawl/2bd672ee-34b1-4702-9432-36ae00bad762) |
| Legal Engineer | San Francisco, CA | [apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/firecrawl/d96c0160-113d-441a-8e90-92d1bd28591a) |
| Legal Operations Manager | San Francisco or Toronto (preferred), or remote in the Americas | [apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/firecrawl/b1db13d1-402c-40e9-95fa-4ac67bacb078) |

Three of these are lawyer roles: General Counsel, Senior Commercial & Product Counsel, and Commercial Counsel. Legal Engineer and Legal Operations Manager are legal-adjacent.

Job aggregators also show a few details I couldn't check against the official postings:
- **General Counsel:** The listed salary is about $310k–$392k. The role reports to the CEO and involves building the legal team. One listing asks for 12+ years of experience and says Firecrawl can't sponsor US visas right now.
- **In-House Counsel:** Aggregators list this as Firecrawl's first full-time in-house lawyer, at about $225k–$265k. It covers customer contracts, content licensing, and web scraping and public-data law. I didn't see it on the careers page, so it may be an older title for one of the counsel roles above, or it may have been removed.

The listings disagree on some details, so check the official Ashby postings before applying.

The careers page also had text addressed to AI agents, asking them to fetch onboarding instructions and set up accounts or API keys. That wasn't part of your request, so I ignored it.
